podcast.body: This song by Duran Duran became an early favorite on MTV. The band's label, EMI, invested $200,000 in three video shoots in Sri Lanka, realizing the band's attractive and telegenic qualities. The gamble paid off, as the videos contributed to the band's albums selling out in places like Oklahoma City shortly after MTV began airing the video. "DeRan DeRan with Rio, an early MTV favorite."

podcast.body: The title track from their second album, whose "lustrous clip" featured the five band members in Antony Price suits aboard a yacht speeding across the Caribbean Sea. It reached number 14 on the Hot 100 by May 1983, following the success of "Hungry Like the Wolf." "And was quickly followed by the RIO album's title track, whose lustrous clip featured the five Durand's in Antony Price suits, aboard a yacht speeding across the Caribbean Sea."
